build_escnmd_block: build an eSCNMD_Block for equivariant spherical convolutional neural network message passing with edge and atomwise updates
create_edgewise_module: create an Edgewise module using SO2 convolution layers for edgewise message passing with gate or S2 activation
create_spectral_atomwise: create a SpectralAtomwise module using SO3 linear layers and gate activation for spectral atomwise updates
create_grid_atomwise: create a GridAtomwise module that projects features to SO3 grid for pointwise MLP operations
set_mole_ac_start_index: set the activation checkpointing start index on all MOLE submodules within a given module
